hypotheses.S0_singleton_utility_selects_route: Choosing the three layers whose singleton programs have highest full-response objective reaches median fidelity >=0.95 and 10th percentile >=0.80 on both corpora.
hypotheses.S1_leaveout_necessity_selects_route: Choosing the three layers whose removal most changes the full Fisher Gram reaches the same thresholds.
hypotheses.S2_self_contained_energy_selects_route: Choosing the three singleton attention derivatives with largest Gram change from the direct route reaches the same thresholds without using the full response as a scoring target.
hypotheses.S3_strong_layer_synergy: All simple selectors fail the 0.80 lower-tail threshold and exhaustive objective selection improves 10th-percentile fidelity by at least 0.10 on either corpus.
